mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 40 degrees under a New Moon.

City crews are performing pavement repairs this Tuesday and Wednesday, which will include milling and patching on streets like North Nine Mound Road and Todd Street. Also, the Plan Commission will meet December 7 to review development projects, including a site plan and traffic analysis for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy week for entertainment. Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Also, stop by Insight Wellness tomorrow for yoga, or gear up for trivia night on Tuesday at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's.
Regarding local safety, on October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they arrested a man for his first O W I offence after he was found asleep in his vehicle.
Culver's of Verona is featuring the delicious Snickers Swirl flavor today, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
